headline: Harare City Council Halts Housing Demolitions Across Zimbabwe Capital
summary: Harare City Council suspended all housing demolition operations with immediate effect pending a review, halting planned municipal enforcement actions across the city.
why: Harare's urban planning decisions and property regulation directly impact real estate investment and municipal governance in Zimbabwe.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: Suspending property demolitions provides temporary stability for informal housing residents.
